meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把插件版本号同步更新到 8 个清单文件,重新构建、提交并推送代码,打 git 标签,创建 GitHub Release,生成更新日志,并发送 Discord 通知;npm 发布会交给你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要求为插件发布新版本或升级版本号(修复/新功能/不兼容改动)时触发。

say.text: 帮我发一个 v1.2.3 的补丁版本
say.note: 它会按流程改版本、构建、提交、打标签并推送。

say.text: 升个 minor 版本,顺便生成更新日志和 GitHub Release
准备发 v2.0.0,记得把 npm 发布留给手动做
say.note: 它会提交推送并提示你手动执行 npm publish。

howto.what_en: Claude bumps the version in 8 manifest files, rebuilds, commits/pushes everything, tags the release, creates a GitHub Release, regenerates the changelog, and sends a Discord notification. npm publishing is left for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to release a new plugin version or bump the version (patch/minor/major).

say_en.text: Bump a patch release to v1.2.3 for me.
say_en.note: It updates version, builds, commits, tags, and pushes.

say_en.text: Do a minor version bump and also generate the changelog and GitHub Release.
say_en.note: Creates release and updates CHANGELOG.md afterwards.

say_en.text: Get v2.0.0 ready, but leave the npm publish step for me.
say_en.note: It commits and pushes and asks you to run npm publish manually.
